lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots organized into distinct vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, forming a dense cluster between the fifth gill slit and the pectoral fin origin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary spot columns, particularly visible in the mid-flank region where spots act as vertex nodes for the vertical and horizontal pattern alignment.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal carinae are visible; the most prominent ridge originates posterior to the dorsal margin of the gills, exhibiting a sharp pixel intensity transition from highlight to shadow across its horizontal axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Non-uniform distribution of discrete high-luminance blobs within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, predominantly clustered near the base and anterior leading edge.
